name: Verőce (Hungary)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Verőce (a red and green shield with a patriarchal cross, a bunch of grapes and a wavy stripe) above the name VERŐCE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
